udf_spec.prompt_template: Given the follow-up duration in months: {follow_up_duration_overall_months}, categorize it into one of the following buckets: '<12', '12–23', or '≥24'.  If the input is null, return null.

final_sql: SELECT follow_up_bucket, count(*) FROM pg_temp."bucketed_followup" GROUP BY follow_up_bucket;
answer_hint: The query counts occurrences of each follow-up bucket
